in_marathi.name: Gourangi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gourangi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gourangi is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Govinda,' which means 'Lord of the Cows.' This name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is revered in Hinduism as the protector and preserver of all beings, and is particularly known for his love for cows.
